prompt_md: A 10 m log is sawn into 1 m pieces. Each cut takes exactly 1 minute. How many minutes does the whole job take?
prompt_short: 10 m log into 1 m pieces, 1 minute per cut. Total minutes?
explain_intuition_md: Ten pieces need only nine cuts: the last cut leaves two pieces at once. So the job takes 9 minutes, not 10.
explain_math_md: $n$ pieces need $n - 1$ cuts: $10 - 1 = 9$ cuts $\times$ 1 min $= 9$ min.
